prompt: Create a production-ready, seamless tileable square raster texture for a premium responsive web UI. Flat front-on macro surface only: deep cobalt-blue hand-painted plywood, close to #063d78, with extremely subtle real brush drag, faint wood grain, a few nearly invisible pigment variations and tiny handcrafted imperfections. Uniform illumination, low contrast, no vignette, no perspective, no objects, no borders, no text, no lettering, no symbols, no flowers, no gold, no gradient bands. It must remain quiet behind white interface text and read as tactile Mumbai sign-painter workshop material rather than noise. 1024 x 1024, perfectly tileable edges.
